question: Where can I get a list of stand-alone battery storage (BESS) projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No public national register of US stand-alone BESS in permitting was found; siting is decided by some state boards and by counties or cities. The October 2026 EIA-860M inventory (released 2026-11-24) reports 33 stand-alone battery plants of 1 MW or more with regulatory approvals pending (status L, 4,799.3 MW), a national proxy with coordinates, MW and entity but no permit dates. Its broader inventory has 250 stand-alone plants across all planned statuses, including projects before approvals, already approved or in construction. State boards (CA, WA, MA, CT, MN) and county or city records (Gillespie County and Baytown, Texas) provide administrative stages and dates.
main_caveats: The September 2026 EIA-860M approvals-pending subset (L) omitted 4 of 5 CA Opt-In BESS under review, WA Goldeneye and MA EFSB 26-01/26-02. Compare EIA and local dockets by scope and dated snapshot.
EIA-860M has no stand-alone flag: exclude Plant IDs with any non-battery generator in the Planned or Operating sheet. Interconnection queues (ERCOT GIS, LBNL) show grid study status, not permits.
Statuses can disagree: CA CEC shows Potentia-Viridi (400 MW) as 'Compliance - Pre-Construction' while EIA-860M October 2026 lists it as '(U) Under construction'.

Cross-source matching is weak: project LLC names differ from developers and MW can differ (CA Vaca Dixon 157 MW vs EIA 'Vaca BESS' 59.5 MW, 0.33 km apart). Match on coordinates or county plus name; flag doubtful matches.
In Texas, checked stage evidence came only from county and city records (Gillespie County, Baytown); Fort Bend County, ERCOT and the PUCT rejected automated requests.
answer.confidence_reason: EIA counts were reproduced on two editions and every state page and Texas record was reopened in this pass. Coverage is a sample (about 10 states, 3 Texas local bodies); doubtful matches are flagged.

attributes.note: EIA and the CA REST service give coordinates; WA, MA, CT and MN pages give town, county or street address; Texas county/city records give address or legal tract.
attributes.gap_note: No national permitting list exists in the pages checked. About 40 state processes and most county and municipal records were not checked; EIA omits many early state and local cases.

attributes.note: EIA gives nameplate MW (no MWh in the Planned sheet); CA, WA, CT and MN pages state MW. The Texas county/city records opened give no MW.
attributes.gap_note: MW is missing from the Texas local records opened; unchecked states and counties may hold it in filings. ERCOT GIS can be used as a Texas cross-check, not as a permit source.

attributes.note: EIA Entity Name is usually the project LLC; state dockets and Texas local records name applicants (e.g. Peregrine Energy Solutions, Balanced Rock Power).
attributes.gap_note: Parent developers behind project LLCs are not consolidated anywhere checked; unchecked states and counties remain.

attributes.note: State dockets and local records show real stages (application review, draft permit, SUP approved, stop-work). EIA status codes P/L/T/U/V/TS are coarse.
attributes.gap_note: No national source tracks local zoning, fire-code or state permit stages; checked: about 10 state portals and 3 Texas local bodies. Other states and counties not checked.

attributes.note: Dated filings, orders and approvals in state dockets and local records (e.g. CT Petition 1728 received 2026-11-17). EIA gives only planned operation month/year.
attributes.gap_note: EIA publishes no permit dates. Dates exist only in scattered state and local records; most counties and about 40 states were not checked.

sources.name: Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory (Form EIA-860M), Planned sheet
sources.summary: National planned-generator proxy with exact coordinates, MW and entity; its status code is not a permit stage and it has no permit dates.
sources.coverage_note: October 2026 inventory: 33 stand-alone battery plants with approvals pending. Across all planned statuses there are 250 plants, including 21 approved, 139 under construction or complete, and 57 before approvals.
caveats: Misses many early state and local cases (CA, WA, MA, CT, MN, Texas examples in this record).
Stand-alone must be derived across Plant IDs in the Planned and Operating sheets.
Status can disagree with the permitting authority; record both.

problems: No permitting stage detail or permit dates.
Edition URLs move from /xls/ to /archive/xls/ after the next release; the old /xls/ address redirects to an error page.

sources.name: State energy facility siting boards and commissions with BESS dockets (sampled)
sources.publisher: State siting authorities (CA CEC, WA EFSEC, MA EFSB, CT Siting Council, MN PUC, OR EFSC, NY ORES, VA DEQ, MI PSC)
sources.format: ArcGIS REST JSON (CA); HTML docket pages with PDF filings (other states)
sources.license: Public state records (terms vary by state)
sources.summary: Start here for real permitting stages and dates where a state siting route exists (CA, MN, WA, MA, CT).
sources.coverage_note: Nine state portals listed; stand-alone BESS dockets found in CA (6 in scope), MN (17 of 20 listed, by description), WA (1), MA (2), CT (1-2). VA and MI blocked.
caveats: Only states with a state siting route; most BESS elsewhere are permitted locally.
Separate hybrids from stand-alone projects using the description.
CA REST omits the developer; use the project page.

problems: VA DEQ and MI PSC pages answer 403 to automated requests.
No developer field in the CA REST service.

example.example_result: Seahawk | 26-OPT-02 | Under Review | 200 | Santa Cruz | Application Being Reviewed for Completeness by CEC Staff | 36.951874, -121.758846; Potentia-Viridi | 24-OPT-04 | Approved - Pre-Construction | 400 | Alameda | completeness 2025-08-29.

members_summary.scope_note: 50 states; 9 portals listed, 7 opened, 5 with stand-alone BESS cases. County and municipal authorities are not in this group (see s005 for Texas).
members_summary.pattern: Search '<state> energy facility siting' or '<state> PUC site permit energy storage'; look for an open-dockets or projects page per technology.

sources.name: Texas county and municipal BESS records (sampled)
sources.publisher: Gillespie County; City of Baytown; Fort Bend County (Texas)
sources.format: HTML pages and PDF filings (some scanned)
sources.summary: Texas sample: county and city records give dated local stages and applicants for BESS that EIA-860M does not list.
sources.coverage_note: Gillespie County (Rogers Draw: stop-work 2025-12-05, injunction 2026-01-21) and Baytown (2 SUPs approved 2025). Fort Bend blocked.
caveats: No MW in the records checked.
Sample of 3 local bodies; no Texas-wide local register found.
Matches to ERCOT GIS are by name and area only.

problems: Fort Bend County agenda documents return 403 (Cloudflare) to automated requests.
Some court filings are scanned images without text.

members_summary.scope_note: Texas counties and municipalities; universe not enumerated in this pass. 3 local bodies sampled (one county with a dedicated BESS page, one city with a permit-application feed, one county agenda system that blocks access).
members_summary.pattern: Search '<county or city> BESS', 'battery energy storage special use permit <city> TX' or 'reinvestment zone battery energy storage <county>'; look for News Flash permit-application posts, DocumentCenter pages and commissioners court agendas.

if_unstructured.summary: Stages and dates sit in state docket systems (CA, MN, CT, WA, MA) and in county or city records (Texas examples). Each needs page-by-page reading; EIA gives coordinates for cross-checks.

local_terms.term: Special Use Permit (SUP) / Conditional Use Permit (CUP)
local_terms.meaning: City or county land-use approval for a BESS site (e.g. Baytown, Texas).
Minnesota PUC permit required for storage of 10 MW or more.
Optional California Energy Commission route for storage of 200 MWh or more.
Connecticut Siting Council route used for small BESS (e.g. Petition 1728).

local_terms.term: Certificate of Environmental Impact and Public Interest
local_terms.meaning: Massachusetts EFSB certificate sought by BESS applicants.

local_terms.term: Stop work order / Notice of Violation
local_terms.meaning: County enforcement record (fire marshal, floodplain administrator) that dates a BESS stage in Texas.

local_terms.term: Reinvestment zone / tax abatement agreement (Tax Code ch. 312)
local_terms.meaning: Texas county or city record that names a BESS project and its site.

local_terms.term: Status codes P, L, T, U, V, TS
local_terms.meaning: EIA-860/860M planned-unit stages from approvals not initiated to construction complete.

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
